WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Developeris theowner of thefeesimple title tocertain land located in the Borough of Queens, City, County and State of New York, known as Block 33, Lot 14 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street addresses 5-21 through 5-29 51s Avenue, and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land improvements existing thereon as of the date hereof being hereinafter referred to as the "Developer Building"), upon which Developer proposes to construct a new or substantially renovated building; WHEREAS,Brownstone Owner is the owner of the fee simple title to certain land located in the Borough of Queens, City, County and State of New York,known as Block 33, Lot 113 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 5-31 51" Avenue, and more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being referred to herein as the "Brownstone Parcel,"and such buildings and improvements located thereon being hereinafter collectively referred to as "Brownstone Building", and the Brownstone Parcel together with the Brownstone Building being referred to as the “Brownstone Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new or substantially newbuilding on the WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the Developer New Building will contain more floor area than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant totheZoningResolutionfor combining theDeveloperParcel and theBrownstone Parcel into a single zoning lot for the purpose of making available to the Developer Parcel the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction of theDeveloperNewBuilding,andBrownstone Owner is willing to make such -1-

Excess Development Rights available to Developer in perpetuity; WHEREAS,thepartiesheretohaveexecutedandrecordedin.thelandrecordsa Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions and an amendment thereto (hereinafter referred to collectively as the"Declaration") in accordance with Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to create a single zoning lot, which Declaration may incorporate parcels other than the Developer Parcel and the Brownstone Parcel, or which Declaration may be hereafter amended to incorporate additional parcels; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their matters; NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of the premises and the mutual covenants hereinaftercontained,thepartiesheretohereby agree asfollows: CertainDefinitions.As used herein: "Excess Development Rights" shall mean all of the Floor Area Development Rights (as such term is hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Brownstone Parcel minus the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by the Brownstone Building as of the date hereof. "Floor area","floor area ratio", "zoning-lot", "parties in interest", "use" and "bulk" shall have the meanings set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. "Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined (i) by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district or districts in which such zoning lot is located, and (ii) by the inclusion of any available bonus floor area permitted under the Zoning Resolution. "Zoning Resolution"shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork, effective as of December 15,1961, as amended from time to time. 2.
